protocol.data: synthetic binary classification; independent training, reference, and current windows
protocol.threshold_selection: fixed existing defaults; no threshold tuning on these results
protocol.null_definition: none: unchanged features, conditional label rule, and label noise
protocol.repeated_unit: one newly trained model and two independent monitoring windows per seed
protocol.paired_scenarios: same training and reference data reused across scenarios for each seed
protocol.false_alert_definition: alert triggered in the no-drift scenario
protocol.interval: Wilson 95% binomial interval across independent seeds within each scenario
protocol.limitation: synthetic repeated trials; not production traffic, a locked evaluation set, or a guarantee about future alerts
